preconditions.description: The input contains exactly A + 1 lines: the first line with dimensions and A lines for the picture.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == B for row in picture_lines)
preconditions.description: Each of the A picture lines contains exactly B characters.
The dimensions A and B are positive integers not exceeding 20.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() and c.isalpha() for row in picture_lines for c in row)
preconditions.description: The picture consists only of uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is the count of good puzzle pairs (X, Y).
There is at least one good puzzle (the whole picture itself is always good).
The second line outputs the pair (X, Y) with minimal area, breaking ties by minimal X.

postconditions.expression: all((A % X == 0 and B % Y == 0) for X, Y in good_pairs)
postconditions.description: Every counted pair (X, Y) divides the picture dimensions A and B respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(is_good_puzzle(X, Y, picture_lines) for X, Y in good_pairs)
postconditions.description: Every counted pair (X, Y) results in a puzzle where no two pieces are identical under rotation.
The second line of output contains the X and Y of the best pair separated by a space.
